name: Media Decompose (Video -> Parts)
purpose: Decompose one video (or media) file into its constituent parts with ffmpeg/ffprobe. Always returns structured probe metadata (container, per-stream codec/resolution/fps/pixel-format/bitrate/channels/sample-rate, stream counts). Opt-in flags additionally: extract the primary audio track to WAV (composing audio.ingest #10, whisper-ready 16 kHz mono s16 by default), extract up to N representative keyframe PNGs (scene-change preferred, else evenly spaced, with a frame/timestamp sidecar), and detect scene-change boundaries. Deterministic; CPU-only; no model. The video analog of audio.ingest #10 and image.util #15, and the first module of the Phase C video spine (architectural position 19).

invocation.args_spec: Named params -InputFile <path> (required); -Audio (switch, extract primary audio via audio.ingest); -AudioFormat <wav|mp3|flac|opus|ogg|m4a> (default wav); -Loudness <none|peak|ebu> (default none); -Keyframes <N> (extract up to N PNG keyframes; 0=off); -Scenes (switch, scene-change detection); -SceneThreshold <0..1> (default 0.4); -FfmpegPath/-FfprobePath <override>; -AudioIngestPath <override to Invoke-AudioIngest.ps1>; -PwshPath <override for spawning audio.ingest>. OR -InputsJson '<json {input,audio,audio_format,loudness,keyframes,scenes,scene_threshold,ffmpeg_path,ffprobe_path,audio_ingest_path,pwsh_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Path to the source video/media file.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: Extract the primary audio stream to an audio file by composing audio.ingest #10 (whisper-ready 16 kHz mono s16 WAV by default). Reports no_audio_stream cleanly if the input has none.

inputs.name: audio_format
inputs.description: Passthrough to audio.ingest: wav | mp3 | flac | opus | ogg | m4a.

inputs.name: loudness
inputs.description: Passthrough to audio.ingest: none | peak | ebu (EBU R128).

inputs.name: keyframes
inputs.description: Extract up to N representative frames as PNGs (scene-change preferred, else evenly spaced). 0 disables.

inputs.name: scenes
inputs.description: Run scene-change detection and emit a JSON list of {index,start,end,score}.

inputs.name: scene_threshold
inputs.description: Scene-change score threshold (0..1) for -Scenes and scene-preferred -Keyframes.

inputs.name: ffmpeg_path
inputs.description: Explicit ffmpeg path override (else resolved from PATH / known locations).

inputs.name: ffprobe_path
inputs.description: Explicit ffprobe path override (else the sibling of the resolved ffmpeg).

inputs.name: audio_ingest_path
inputs.description: Explicit path to audio.ingest's Invoke-AudioIngest.ps1 (else ../10-audio-ingest sibling).

inputs.name: pwsh_path
inputs.description: Explicit pwsh path used to spawn audio.ingest (else resolved from $PSHOME / PATH).

outputs.description: { input{path,exists,bytes}, meta{container{format_name,duration_s,size_bytes,bit_rate,nb_streams}, streams[{index,codec_type,codec_name,...type-specific...}], stream_counts{video,audio,subtitle,data,other,total}, duration_s}, operations{audio,keyframes,scenes}, audio{requested,extracted,path,format,codec,sample_rate,channels,duration_s,bytes,sha256,composed_skill,composed_invocation_id,composed_status} | {requested,extracted:false,reason}, keyframes{requested_n,source,count,threshold,sidecar_path,frames[{index,timestamp_s,source,score,path,bytes,sha256}]} | null, scenes{threshold,count,duration_s,path,scenes[{index,start,end,score}]} | null, ffmpeg{path,version}, ffprobe{path} }
